channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Democrats press White House on prediction market betting by staff
item.description: The inquiry builds on a July case involving Trump’s teleprompter operator, who allegedly made $100,000 betting on his speeches.

item.title: Claude can now join video calls as an active, visible teammate in Anthropic’s latest push to reinvent white collar jobs beyond coding
item.description: A suite of new products could be among Anthropic's latest big launches before its IPO, likely on Nov. 19.

item.title: One mom tallied 23 hours a week of household work. Then she built a company to turn ‘invisible labor’ into a paid profession
item.description: Sage Haus founder Kelly Hubbell now places house managers with families in the U.S. and Canada.

item.title: Elon Musk wants to build AI satellite factories on the moon—and now SpaceX will compete for NASA’s $10 billion in contracts to build a lunar base
item.description: NASA wants to put astronauts on the moon for the long haul, while SpaceX envisions industrializing it long-term.
